SpotiKit 0.9.1 focuses the Marketplace on what's made for SpotiKit and makes it nicer to use.

## Marketplace

- **Made for SpotiKit.** The Marketplace now only lists themes, extensions, apps and snippets made for SpotiKit. Items from other catalogs that were installed through SpotiKit are removed when Spotify starts, and you get a short note about it.
- **Shared profiles have their own page.** Open a shared setup profile to read its description and see everything in it, sorted into theme, extensions, apps and snippets. Each item opens its own page.
- **Big profiles fit on the screen.** The **Use** dialog scrolls when a profile has a lot of items, and its buttons always stay in view.
- **Trusted items update by themselves.** Turn on **Update automatically** on an item's page, or **Update it by itself from now on** when SpotiKit asks. New versions then install when Spotify starts.
- **Fewer questions.** The update prompt at start can be switched off with **Don't ask when Spotify starts**, and back on with **Notify me about updates** in **Installed**.
- **New snippet** is at the top of **CSS Snippets** now.
- Switching tabs starts at the top of the page, and the tab animation is calmer.

## SpotiKit app

- **Open the docs** on the **Developer** page takes you straight to the guides on spotikit.com.

## For developers

- SpotiKit finds Spotify's components and services in a new way. Your themes and extensions keep working as before.
- `SpotiKit.Components.Cards.CardImage` now returns the artwork of a card. It returned the playlist card before.
- `SpotiKit.GraphQL.definitions` finds every definition, including ones it missed before.
- Scripts that rely on other mods' APIs don't run in SpotiKit anymore. `spotikit-kit check` points them out.

## Good to know

SpotiKit updates itself, so you don't have to do anything. `SpotiKit.exe.sha256` holds the checksum of `SpotiKit.exe`, if you want to verify your download.
